description: DplyCliCommandCatalog lists commands by hand, so nothing fails when packages/dply-cli gains a command or when the catalog advertises one that does not exist - both happened. A direct comparison is underspecified: the catalog holds examples, aliases and multiple rows per handler, while the CLI dispatches through nested switches. Define canonical command IDs and alias rules first, ideally exported as a machine-readable CLI manifest, then test both directions: every advertised command resolves, every public command is advertised or explicitly exempt.
title: Canonical CLI command IDs, then a two-way catalog parity check
